summary_zh: 前文为同作者转述 Naver 新闻，核心是 BTS Jin 的 Laneige“晚安挑战”在小红书走热。收录帖把话题落到品牌活动、睡眠面膜/眼贴销量第一及售罄等商品表现，未涉及价格、配送或个人体验。后续仅呼吁点赞分享，无他人补充；可判断情绪正向、传播偏粉丝扩散，真实性主要依赖新闻转述。

posts.text:
[Naver News Update 📰]

Jin’s Sweet “Good Night” Greeting from #BTSJIN… Xiao hongshu hot trends “As Expected of Laneige’s Face”

🗣️Moon Wan-sik “BTS's Jin radiated the charm of 'worldwide handsome' with her dazzling beauty and sweet voice, which heated up fans around the world.

Amorepacific's beauty brand Laneige released the 'Jin's Good Night Challenge' video as part of the campaign with global ambassador Jin.

Jin attempted the word “good night” in Korean, Chinese, Japanese, and English, drawing significant attention. Approximately two days after the video was posted on Laneige’s official SNS, it surpassed 13 million views on Xiaohongshu, China’s leading SNS and e-commerce platform, becoming a hot trending topic. On Xiaohongshu, where the algorithm operates based on user searches, it’s rare for an advertising video to achieve over 10 million views. Xiaohongshu users praised Jin’s stunning appearance, his gentle voice delivering the “good night” greeting, and his pronunciation, showering him with rave reviews.

Meanwhile, Laneige recently released a new Sleeping Mask campaign with Jin. As soon as it was released, the sleeping mask lined up from the first place in the Laneige brand store. On the same day, 'Laneige Bounce and Firm Sleeping Mask' was sold out after taking the first place in the sales quantity ranking (beauty) of Naver 'Chuseok + Sale'. The Jin Photo sticker gift set of Water Sleeping Mask and Sika Sleeping Mask was also sold out, and it was changed to a mini photo book gift set.

Laneige U.S. In (USA), Jin's Bounce and Firm Hydrogel Eye Patch was released with Jin's campaign video. 'Laneige Face' Jin is launching a large-scale campaign all over the world, such as decorating stores with large photos of Jin”.

 #방단소년단진 #진 #Jin @BTS_twt

posts.translation_zh:
[Naver 新闻更新 📰]

Jin 来自 #BTSJIN 的甜蜜“晚安”问候……小红书热门趋势“果然是 Laneige 的门面”

🗣️Moon Wan-sik：“BTS 的 Jin 以耀眼的美貌和甜美的嗓音散发出‘worldwide handsome’的魅力，让全球粉丝为之沸腾。

Amorepacific 旗下美妆品牌 Laneige 发布了‘Jin’s Good Night Challenge’视频，作为与全球大使 Jin 合作的活动的一部分。

Jin 尝试用韩语、中文、日语和英语说‘晚安’，引发了极大关注。视频发布在 Laneige 官方 SNS 约两天后，在中国领先的 SNS 和电商平台小红书上播放量突破 1300 万，成为热门趋势话题。在小红书这样基于用户搜索运行算法的平台上，广告视频获得超过 1000 万播放量是很罕见的。小红书用户称赞 Jin 惊艳的外貌、他用温柔嗓音送出的‘晚安’问候以及他的发音，对他好评如潮。

与此同时，Laneige 最近发布了与 Jin 合作的全新 Sleeping Mask 活动。刚一发布，睡眠面膜就在 Laneige 品牌店中排到第一。同日，‘Laneige Bounce and Firm Sleeping Mask’在 Naver ‘Chuseok + Sale’销量排行榜（美妆）中拿下第一后售罄。Water Sleeping Mask 和 Sika Sleeping Mask 的 Jin Photo sticker 礼盒也已售罄，并更换为迷你写真书礼盒。

Laneige 美国（USA）方面，Jin 的 Bounce and Firm Hydrogel Eye Patch 随 Jin 的活动视频一起发布。‘Laneige Face’ Jin 正在全球范围内展开大型活动，例如用 Jin 的大幅照片装饰门店。”

 #방단소년단진 #진 #Jin @BTS_twt
